criteria.notes: The experience is a multilingual touch directory with search, visitor-controlled pan and zoom, persistent current-position and target pulses, optional evidence-bounded directional guidance, and no invented walking route.
The supplied tourism map remains the authoritative visual source while the overlay adds only reviewed SVG hit targets and guidance markers.
The Veszprem identity, bilingual destination data, map artwork, kiosk controls, and focused detail state read as a venue-specific product.
Directory names, selected destination titles, map controls, and guidance statements remain legible at both validated surfaces.
Default and custom palettes preserve contrast for text, controls, selected markers, and muted map content.
Long title, long directory row, and long selected destination scenarios wrap or scroll without clipping or overlap.
Map and directory remain balanced at 1920x1080 and 1366x768; scroll replaces ambiguous pagination and selected states keep controls visible.
The source map renders sharply, custom colors propagate, current and selected markers pulse distinctly, and the venue-confirmed facing arrow remains separate from destination guidance.
The example follows the supplied cartographic visual language rather than imposing the dashboard style used by unrelated examples.

screenshots.notes: Full-HD directory is complete and uncluttered, with the current-position marker visible before interaction.
Compact surface preserves the map, directory hierarchy, and touch targets.
One destination is isolated with a strong pulsing spotlight and no false route line or automatic viewport change.
Scenario render matches the reviewed Full-HD default image byte-for-byte.
Compact behavior render has no clipping, overlap, or inaccessible controls.
Custom palette changes visible chrome and controls while retaining contrast.
Pulsing origin and target remain distinct, the map-relative facing arrow and compass direction are readable, and the UI explicitly states that it is not a walking path.
Empty data produces a centered, legible empty state without disturbing map controls.
A destination without reviewed map geometry is honestly reported as not shown on this map.
The large on-screen keyboard exposes the typed value, Hungarian and English layouts, and unambiguous touch actions.
A live table update replaces the visible directory row without stale content.
Long destination text remains readable and the directory remains continuously scrollable.
Long selected names and descriptions wrap within the detail panel without obscuring the highlight.
The long venue title remains on one readable header line at the validated compact surface.
The supported row-array datasource shape renders the complete directory correctly.
